headline: Patel Engineering Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - Patel Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Patel Engineering in joint venture has been declared lowest bidder (L1) for an irrigation project of Rs. 133.25 crore from Maharashtra Krishna Valley Development…
detail: Updates - Patel Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Patel Engineering in joint venture has been declared lowest bidder (L1) for an irrigation project of Rs. 133.25 crore from Maharashtra Krishna Valley Development Corporation. Patel Engineering share in the contract is Rs. 67.96 crore'.
